name: Hair loss bundle -Side effects added and final question altered. May 2024
description: It's essential to answer all questions truthfully so we can treat you safely and appropriately.

questions.text: I need to check your age, please select the category below that applies to you:

As you're over 49, I want to tell you that Regaine foam is technically being prescribed off-label. This means the drug company licence only covers up to the age of 49, but it's commonly used by men over this age.

options.text: I'd rather NOT have Regaine, please change my prescription to Finasteride tablets only.

questions.text: When did you start losing your hair?
How did your hair loss start?
Sudden hair loss is unusual. These treatments are specifically designed to treat the initial stages of male pattern baldness, which usually happens gradually.

Not sure, but I understand that if I don't see improvement or slowing of my hair loss after 6 months, continuing to take treatment is unlikely to be effective for me.

questions.text: I want to check your understanding of the hair loss treatment. Please tell me: You will need to take the treatment for at least 3-6 months before you see any benefit, and stopping treatment will reverse any regrowth and hair loss will resume.
The medication takes several months to work and so you won’t start to see a benefit for 3-6 months
Please note that these medicines can affect prostate blood test results. If you need a prostate blood test, tell your doctor that you take finasteride or propecia.
